newsitem.title: GERMANY: European central bank must be independent-Chirac.
newsitem.headline: European central bank must be independent-Chirac.

text.p: French President Jacques Chirac said on Monday that the future European Central Bank must be independent of political power.
"The independence of the European Central Bank is an absolute necessity," he told a news conference after a Franco-German summit.
But he said that there must be a political power to counterbalance the independent monetary authority.
"France believes...that there will have to be political power as a counterpart to the European Central Bank," Chirac said.
He noted that it was governments' prerogative to fix the external parities of currencies.
He said the exact nature of this political power would have to be defined between now and the launch of a single European currency, planned for January 1, 1999.
